slice_items.text: 安装、托盘、灵魂向导（权限默认全关）。
slice_items.assessment: AC-01 covers installation/tray/no elevation; AC-02 covers default-off configuration after onboarding.

slice_items.text: 问卷 + soul-import-v1 JSONL / Telegram result.json。
slice_items.assessment: AC-03/04/05 cover the questionnaire and both named import paths; AC-25 covers hostile imported content.

slice_items.text: 可编辑档案（特质轴/偏好/边界）+ 人脉图 v0；推断带证据与证据档。
slice_items.assessment: AC-28–30 now pin T4D's direct/group split and one-global-as_of behavior at the product boundary, while AC-32 pins the effective corrected tie band. No row explicitly performs and verifies edits to both preferences and boundaries, so this compound slice is not fully covered.

slice_items.text: 用户纠正锁定，后续推断不覆盖；起草语气立即改变。
slice_items.assessment: AC-07 verifies a user tone edit changes drafting and is not overwritten; AC-31 verifies A0 intake/replay honors a locked axis; AC-32 verifies locked tie correction survives rebuild and is consumed by graph/A2.

slice_items.text: 自传记忆 CRUD + 遗忘（销毁内容密钥）+ 影响面预览。
slice_items.assessment: AC-14 covers memory CRUD and content-free audit; AC-15 covers impact preview, key destruction, restart, orphaning, and retained audit.

slice_items.text: 单人人事分析摘要（无 key 时统计降级，禁止诊断词）。
slice_items.assessment: AC-16/17 cover evidence, no-diagnosis language, and no-key fallback. AC-32 makes A2 consume the effective corrected band; AC-33 pins split-field rendering, omission on absence, and the ban on recomputation or a second threshold set.

slice_items.text: 可选前台应用采集；关闭后 1 秒内无新事件；未同意时事件数为 0。
slice_items.assessment: AC-09/10 cover default-off zero events and the one-second stop bound.

slice_items.text: 粘贴消息按档案语气起草，不发送；默认 E1 请求体第三人正文已占位。
slice_items.assessment: AC-11/12/13 cover no-send, E1 origin, default redaction, and a one-shot exception; AC-07/17 cover tone and deterministic fallback; AC-25 covers prompt injection.

slice_items.text: 授权目录后只读扫描并生成整理计划预览；v0.1 不执行写；未授权路径 100% 拒绝。
slice_items.assessment: AC-18 covers read-only preview, disk invariance, and unauthorized rejection; AC-19/25 cover execution refusal and hostile filenames.

slice_items.text: 研究导出只预览；第三人行数为 0；不写文件。
slice_items.assessment: AC-20 directly covers zero third-party rows and written_to_disk=false.

slice_items.text: 云端开关「尚未启用」；零 E0。
slice_items.assessment: AC-21/22 cover zero E0 and the disabled cloud toggle; AC-11/17 delimit the separate user-directed E1 path.

slice_items.text: 审计覆盖采集、导入、推断、纠正、记忆、遗忘、起草、E1、文件计划、拒绝。
slice_items.assessment: AC-32 now explicitly checks correction audit, and AC-14/15/23/24 cover memory, forgetting, broad matrix-action replay, and crash recovery. AC-23 still does not enumerate all ten slice action kinds as separately expected records.
AC-01 includes installation smoke and AC-26 is the repository CI gate.
